issue.title: Retire queue_capacity_budget
issue.description: A %queue capacity value is this launch's runner-capacity budget and replaces max_running_agents for its own admission decision.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The queue-capacity budget semantics, Python wire names, display, and documentation have migrated and the legacy threshold branch can be deleted.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: A %queue capacity value is the legacy pre-admission threshold; max_running_agents still limits the launch and capacity=0 drains to zero.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: A %queue capacity value is this launch's runner-capacity budget and replaces max_running_agents for its own admission decision.
